title: Adoption Velocity Radar — Customer Implementation Compact
summary: One-page compact tracker designed for weekly check-ins with customers running inference rollouts. Focuses on milestone velocity, single-line owner responsibilities, active blockers with mitigation proposals, and suggested next steps. Intentionally terse so CSMs can paste to Slack or QBR notes.

M2: Tokenization & prompt schema locked — Target date 2026-01-15 — Current: in_progress — Owner: Ethan
M3: Latency & cost SLOs defined for production routes — Target date 2026-02-10 — Current: blocked (load tests queued) — Owner: Maya
M4: Dedicated pool config (reserved) approved — Target date 2026-02-28 — Current: in_progress — Owner: Liam

blockers: B1: Load test environment access pending customer IAM approval — Severity: high — Impact: blocks latency SLO validation — Proposed mitigation: escalate via customer security lead, temporary token-based access window

B2: Prompt schema disagreement between product and legal (PII handling) — Severity: medium — Impact: delays final prompt set — Proposed mitigation: sticky note doc + 2pm alignment call, convene Legal + Product

B3: Model quantization profile not validated on customer's on-prem hardware — Severity: medium — Impact: cost/latency estimate uncertain — Proposed mitigation: schedule short remote bench session with ops team; share trimmed test model
